judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer summarizes the BGV theorem as applying to 'most expanding spacetimes' (echoing the injected over-generalisation) without flagging the scope issue or challenging the claim against the cited source Borde-Guth-Vilenkin. No specific flag challenges the 'all expanding' vs 'inflationary' distinction.

The review summary repeats the broadened claim about the BGV theorem applying to 'most expanding spacetimes' but does not challenge it as contradicted, overgeneralised, or unsupported by Borde-Guth-Vilenkin. There is no specific citation-related flag.

The reviewer summarizes the paper's claim regarding the BGV theorem without challenging the over-generalization from inflationary to all expanding spacetimes; in fact, the reviewer describes the mathematical formulations as high quality.

The reviewer does not flag the over-generalisation from 'inflationary spacetimes' to 'all expanding spacetimes' in the abstract.
